public_rationale: By mid-January 2026, the reported suits add up to eight. They are the Raine suit (August 2025), four death cases filed by the Social Media Victims Law Center in November 2025, the Adams estate suit (December 11), the separate Soelberg estate suit (December 29), and the Gordon suit (January 2026). Futurism, writing days before the post, likewise counted 'at least eight ongoing lawsuits' claiming ChatGPT use resulted in a death. Two of these suits arise from the same murder-suicide, but he counted lawsuits, not deaths.
